page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ae.4xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by a dedicated AMD EPYC 9T34 processor. Operating on the x86_64 architecture, this instance features 16 physical cores and 16 vCPUs running at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz, paired with 64.0 GB of RAM. The CPU configuration provides dedicated allocation with one thread per core, supported by a cache hierarchy of 32 KB L1d, 1.0 MB L2, and 32 MB L3 cache. It includes advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 (including VNNI and BF16 variants) and cryptographic acceleration via AES and SHA_NI. The instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

In benchmark evaluations, the ecs.g8ae.4xlarge demonstrates strong single-core performance, placing in the top 10% for stress-ng single-core CPU tests and the top 25% for Geekbench single-core and text processing workloads. Multi-core performance, memory bandwidth, and database operations consistently rank in the average tier (middle 50%). This hardware profile offers a balanced resource density of 4.0 GB RAM per vCPU, making it a qualitatively cost-efficient option for workloads requiring dedicated CPU execution without the premium of memory-optimized or storage-optimized instances. The lack of local storage requires reliance on network-attached storage, which is supported by the 12 Gbps baseline network bandwidth.

This instance is suited for general-purpose workloads, including static web serving, text processing, software compilation, and standard database operations that benefit from strong single-threaded performance and dedicated CPU resources.
